branded.why: The processed cheese that made cheese a Japanese food, mass-made since 1954.

about.text: Snow Brand's best-known processed cheese, mass-produced from 1954 as part of the company's long aim of a processed cheese suited to Japanese tastes. It is not ripened.

sources.text: The company's own timeline: the 1954 mass production of 6P, and its processed-cheese goal.
